sections:
Worked Examples

Days between dates. From January 1, 2026 to December 25, 2026 is 358 days (51 weeks and 1 days).

Adding days. 90 days after November 23, 2026 is February 21, 2027.

Counting Rules to Watch For

  • Whether the start date is counted. Contracts and deadlines often say "within 30 days after", which excludes the start day.
  • Month math: adding one month to January 31 gives the last day of February, since February is shorter.
  • Weekends and holidays are not skipped. For working days, subtract them separately.

Where It Helps

Use it for countdowns, project deadlines, notice periods and due dates. For pregnancy specifically, see the due date calculator; for hours and minutes, the time calculator.

extra_faqs.q: How many days are there in a year?
extra_faqs.a: 365 days, or 366 in a leap year. A leap year occurs every four years except most century years not divisible by 400.

extra_faqs.q: How do I count business days between two dates?
extra_faqs.a: Take the total days, remove weekends, then subtract any holidays that fall on weekdays.

extra_faqs.q: Does the calculator include the end date?
extra_faqs.a: Check the result label. Counting both ends adds one day compared with simple subtraction.
